full_prompt_en: A square, highly graphic digital painting shows a close profile of a woman with short dark textured hair, her face turned upward within a dense geometric mosaic. A large warm gold circle sits behind her head in the upper left, partly hidden by the contours of her forehead and hair. The background is built from stacked rectangles, squares, circles, and narrow stripes in muted teal, rust red, ochre, slate, and cream. At the center, her closed eye and lifted chin form a calm diagonal against the rigid grid. Her facial planes are divided into flat blocks of brown, copper, blue-green, and pale cream, while a few smooth shaded transitions preserve the roundness of her cheeks and lips. A broad gold hoop hangs from her visible ear, with a bright circular stud above it. The hoop's clean curve repeats the pale disc behind the head and stands out against dark teal hair and red-orange patches. Her neck descends toward the lower center, and a black garment or shadowed shoulder anchors the lower left. On the right, large ochre and red rounded forms interrupt the finer tiled marks. Small scratches, faded print-like grain, and uneven pigment specks lie over the otherwise sharply bounded color planes, giving the design a weathered surface. Light is represented through pale gold and cream facets on the upper face and background rather than through a natural cast shadow; the underside of the chin and neck remain darker. The overall composition joins a serene upward silhouette to a tightly interlocked rhythm of warm and cool geometric fragments, with the gold circles supplying its strongest visual echo.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、高度图形化的数字绘画呈现一位短而浓密深发女子的近距离侧影，她在密集几何镶嵌中仰起面庞。左上方一个大而暖金色的圆盘置于头后，部分被额头和头发轮廓遮住。背景由堆叠的矩形、方块、圆形与窄条构成，颜色是低饱和青绿、锈红、赭黄、石板色和奶油色。画面中央，她闭合的眼与抬起的下巴形成安静的斜线，对照僵直网格。面部平面被分成棕、铜、蓝绿和浅奶油色的平坦块面，少量平滑阴影过渡仍保留脸颊和嘴唇的圆润。一只宽大的金色耳环悬于可见耳下，上方有明亮圆形耳钉。耳环的干净曲线重复头后浅色圆盘，在深青绿色头发与红橙色块前凸显。脖颈向下延至中央下部，黑色衣服或阴影肩部稳住左下方。右侧，大块赭黄与红色圆钝形打断更细的镶嵌笔迹。小划痕、褪色印刷般的颗粒和不均匀颜料斑点覆盖原本边界锐利的色面，让设计呈现磨旧表面。光通过脸上部和背景中的浅金、奶油色切面表现，而非自然投影；下巴与颈部下方保持更暗。整体构图把宁静上扬的剪影与紧密互锁的冷暖几何碎片结合，金色圆形提供最强的视觉呼应。
style_prompt_en: The image has a graphic, print-like painted finish assembled from interlocking geometric color planes. Rectangles, discs, narrow stripes, and faceted curves overlap at several scales, creating density without losing a dominant silhouette. Oxidized teal, rust, ochre, dark brown, and muted cream alternate in a warm-cool checkerboard, with concentrated gold areas drawing the eye. Most edges are crisp, but fine scratches, faded grain, and uneven pigment soften their mechanical precision. Volume appears through a few darker facets and selective gradients rather than continuous natural shading. Illumination is encoded as pale warm blocks set against cool dark regions, giving the composition a luminous but largely flat quality. The overall effect is rhythmic, tactile, and boldly ordered.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有由互锁几何色面拼成的图形化、近似印刷的绘画完成面。矩形、圆盘、窄条和切面曲线在多种尺度上叠压，形成密度却不淹没主剪影。氧化青绿、锈红、赭黄、深褐和低饱和奶油色以冷暖棋盘节奏交替，集中的金色区域吸引目光。多数边缘锐利，但细划痕、褪色颗粒和不均匀颜料柔化其机械精度。体积来自少数较深切面和选择性渐变，而非连续自然阴影。照明被编码为与冷暗区域相对的浅暖色块，让构图发亮却大体平面化。整体效果有节奏、可触而大胆有序。
theme_en: An upward-facing profile with gold hoop jewelry amid a geometric mosaic
theme_zh: 戴金色环形耳饰的仰面侧影置于几何马赛克之中
name: Keith Mallett
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
